Clean and simple

Solid deep red typical Indonesian SD uniform
Slightly maroon tone (#8e2b2b – #a93226)
NOT bright red, NOT brown, NOT blackish

Clothing Details

Female: red skirt (knee length)

SLEEVES RULE (STRICT)
Follow original sleeve length
EXCEPTION (STRICT): If subject is wearing hijab → MUST use long sleeves (wrist-length)
Do NOT generate short sleeves for hijab cases

Shoes & Socks
Black casual school shoes
Short ankle socks only

Remove accessories, layers, non-uniform items
Keep face, identity, proportions, all subjects

TASK 2 — Background Replacement
Replace with Reference-2 background
Match lighting, perspective, shadows
Feet must touch ground
No floating, no distortion
No face overlap

GROUND RULE (STRICT)
Completely remove original floor/ground
Do NOT retain any visual elements from the original background, including ground, floor, or shadows
Use only ground from Reference-2

HARD CONSTRAINTS
Keep all original subjects
Do NOT add extra people
Clean result, no artifacts

FINAL OUTPUT
Natural Indonesian elementary school (SD) group photo
